items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: they’ve got a band with Nicholas Payton... and Jeff Hamilton on drums... they’ve got a hell of a, they’ve got a sextet there.

ctx.x: You’re going to Japan with Harry Allen?

Yeah we’ve got him, McKenna, Mike Moore and myself. Then they’ve got, a real nice guy who lives near me, Kenny Burrell, Howard Alden, each with a trio, and then they play together, and then they’ve got a band with Nicholas Payton, some tenor player, good alto player, and Jeff Hamilton on drums, John Clayton, Mike LeDonne, they’ve got a hell of a, they’ve got a sextet there. They’ve got Helen Merrill and her little quartet, Terry Clarke, an old pal of mine, he’s going to be playing drums with them. And let me see,…
I hear they like jazz in Japan a lot.
